entries.title: Requiem Ore
entries.summary: The only source of Requiem Cards

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore} is the only source of <hl>Requiem Cards</hl>, and you'll want a pickaxe with {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed} to mine it. Requiem Cards are the keys for cracking the code of the boss, the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}; see [[requiem/requiem_cards]].
Where to find it

rows: Y <t>{cfg:ore_gen.requiemOreMinHeight}</t> to <t>{cfg:ore_gen.requiemOreMaxHeight}</t>; most common in the middle, rarest at both ends
<t>{cfg:ore_gen.requiemOreVeinCount}</t> veins per chunk, up to about <t>{cfg:ore_gen.requiemOreVeinSize}</t> blocks each
Inside stone and deepslate: the Overworld and other dimensions with stone underground; not the Nether or the End

blocks.text: How to mine it

items: Get a pickaxe with {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed}; where it comes from: [[world/enchantments]]
Diamond or netherite is fastest; an iron pickaxe or other digging tool still gets the drops, just more slowly
Make sure it does not have Silk Touch; Fortune doesn't matter
Find the ore, break it and pick up whatever falls out

blocks.text: What it drops
Each block rolls once: on success everything in the table drops together; on failure you get nothing. The ore block itself never drops.

items: {item:kuvalich:kuva} and {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} are upgrade materials; what they're for: [[start/materials]]
Mods are upgrade cards you install in a weapon or on yourself, split into weapon mods and Warframe mods; tiers are explained in [[modules/module_rarity]]
Mods drop <t>unrevealed</t>: right-click one in your main hand and it turns into a random mod of that tier, see [[modules/module_overview]]
When a mod drops, it's a weapon mod {cfg:kuva_lich.moduleWeaponRatio|pctv} of the time, otherwise a Warframe mod

blocks.text: XP is separate and ignores that roll: break it with a diamond pickaxe or better and each block drops 50-100 XP; with {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed} that is multiplied by {cfg:kuva_lich.expMultiplier|x}. Any other tool, or Silk Touch, gives no XP.

items: kuvalich:fass
kuvalich:jahu

blocks.caption: The eight Requiem Cards; one drops at random

blocks.text: In Warframe these eight are <t>Requiem Mods</t>, and they come from opening Requiem Relics, not from mining.
Success chance
How long one block takes

rows: Requiem Destroyed + diamond pickaxe or better
Requiem Destroyed + iron pickaxe or other digging tool
Diamond pickaxe or better, no Requiem Destroyed
Lower pickaxe, other item or bare hand, no Requiem Destroyed

blocks.title: Efficiency and Haste don't help
blocks.text: As long as you're holding something, the mining speed here is fixed: Efficiency and Haste do nothing. On the bright side, being underwater or in the air doesn't slow you down either.
Advanced details

items: At most one mod tier drops per block, checked Gold, then Silver, then Bronze; if the three add up to more than 100%, the later tiers fall short of their listed chance
The {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate}, {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast} and {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve} are machines that follow the same mining-speed rules as "How long one block takes" above

blocks.title: Use a diamond pickaxe on machines
blocks.text: Picking up those three machines, or the {item:kuvalich:requiem_weapon_table} and {item:kuvalich:requiem_warframe_table}, needs a diamond pickaxe or better; otherwise the block simply vanishes and drops nothing.

entries.title: Experience Ore
entries.summary: Stone-pickaxe ore that gives XP and Endo

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:experience_ore} is an ore you can mine with just a <t>stone pickaxe</t>. It drops XP when broken, plus a 50/50 shot at {item:kuvalich:endo}.
Endo is the material for levelling up mods, and mods are upgrade cards you install in a weapon or on yourself. How levelling works: [[modules/module_level]]; other Endo sources: [[world/loot]].
Mods (upgrade cards you install in a weapon or on yourself) work at full strength as soon as they're installed and never need levelling, so Endo has no use.
Where to find it

rows: Y <t>{cfg:ore_gen.experienceOreMinHeight}</t> to <t>{cfg:ore_gen.experienceOreMaxHeight}</t>, evenly spread over the whole band
<t>{cfg:ore_gen.experienceOreVeinCount}</t> veins per chunk, up to about <t>{cfg:ore_gen.experienceOreVeinSize}</t> blocks each
Inside stone and deepslate: the Overworld and other dimensions with stone underground; not the Nether or the End

blocks.text: What it drops

blocks.title: When it drops nothing
blocks.text: Breaking it with a wooden or golden pickaxe, bare hands or anything that isn't a pickaxe, or with a Silk Touch tool, drops nothing at all, not even the ore block.
In Warframe, Endo also drops straight from missions, and another big source is Ayatan Sculptures: fill them with Ayatan Stars and trade them to Maroo for a large pile of Endo.
Advanced details

items: {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.experience_collector} has no effect on Experience Ore, see [[world/enchantments]]

items.text: The {lang:item.module.oreDropMultiplier} stat on Warframe mods doesn't increase its Endo, see [[world/ore_drop_multiplier]]

entries.title: Unique Enchantments
entries.summary: All six at a glance; Requiem Destroyed, Experience Collector

blocks.text: This mod adds 6 enchantments. Like vanilla ones, they come from the enchanting table and enchanted books, with no special recipe. {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed}, which you need for Requiem Ore, is one of them.

rows: Extra XP from blocks that drop XP
More damage the lower the target's health
×2 to ×3 damage on full-health targets, plus XP
Less damage while you're at full health
Spends XP to survive a lethal hit

blocks.text: Details on the four combat enchantments: [[world/combat_enchantments]].
How to get them

items: Enchanting table: possible, but they're all rare and high levels hardly ever show up
Enchanted books: may turn up in loot chests or with librarian villagers; apply them to a tool, weapon or armor piece with an anvil
For high levels: trade with librarians, search loot chests, or combine two books of the same level on an anvil

blocks.text: {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed}

items: Mining {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore}, and this mod's three machines {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate}, {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast} and {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}, becomes <g>fixed and very fast</g>: about 0.5 s per block with a diamond pickaxe
Without it, all four blocks are painfully slow
The Requiem Ore success chance becomes <g>{cfg:kuva_lich.cardDropChanceWithEnchant|pctv}</g>, and Fortune stops mattering
XP from Requiem Ore is multiplied by <g>{cfg:kuva_lich.expMultiplier|x}</g> (you only get XP with a diamond pickaxe or better)
Never put it on the same tool as Silk Touch: with Silk Touch, Requiem Ore drops nothing

blocks.text: Full drop table and timings: [[world/requiem_ore]].
{lang:enchantment.kuvalich.experience_collector}

When you break a block that already drops XP, it drops some extra XP; think coal, diamond, lapis, redstone, emerald and nether quartz ores, and {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore} too. Can't be combined with Silk Touch.
Extra XP per block: level 1 <g>+2</g>, level 2 <g>+4</g>, level 3 <g>+5</g>, level 4 <g>+7</g>, level 5 <g>+8</g>.

No effect on {item:kuvalich:experience_ore}. If a block drops 0 XP this time, nothing is added either, for example coal that happened to drop none, or the wrong pickaxe. On a pickaxe that also has {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.requiem_destroyed}, the extra XP from Requiem Ore gets multiplied along with the rest.

entries.title: Combat Enchantments
entries.summary: Lethal, First Strike, Escort, Death Resistance

blocks.text: Four combat enchantments: two go on swords for more damage, two go on armor to keep you alive. Where to get them: [[world/enchantments]].
{lang:enchantment.kuvalich.lethal}
The lower the target's health, the bigger the bonus on this hit; there's no bonus against a full-health target.
Bonus damage = hit damage × fraction of the target's health already lost × 15% × level
At level 5 that's <g>+37.5%</g> against a half-health target and about <g>+75%</g> against a nearly dead one.
{lang:enchantment.kuvalich.first_strike}
Against a full-health target, this hit deals multiplied damage and gives you some XP too. Once the target has lost a sliver of health, it stops triggering.
XP is rounded down and capped at 33% of the target's max health and at 1000 points. So small mobs give almost nothing; it pays off on high-health targets.
Lethal and First Strike can't go on the same weapon. Both only count direct melee hits; arrows, gun bullets and other projectiles don't trigger them.
{lang:enchantment.kuvalich.escort}
While you're at full health, damage you take is reduced: level 1 −25%, level 2 −50%, level 3 −75%. It stops as soon as you're hurt: it blunts the first hit, not the whole fight.

items: If several armor pieces have it, only the highest counts; they don't stack
Yellow hearts take the hit first: this mod's [[warframe/shield|shield]] and absorption from things like golden apples both count. Escort only reduces what gets through to your health
While yellow hearts hold, your health stays full, so Escort keeps working

blocks.text: {lang:enchantment.kuvalich.death_resistance}
When a single hit would kill you, it automatically spends XP to leave you at 1 health (half a heart), with a totem sound.
XP points spent = damage of that hit × 4 ÷ enchantment level (rounded up)

items: Example: at level 3, a 30-damage hit costs 40 XP points; a full level-30 XP bar holds about 1395 points
If you don't have enough XP it doesn't trigger: you die as usual and keep your XP
When it triggers, a message above the hotbar shows how much XP it cost
If several armor pieces have it, the highest level counts

blocks.text: Advanced details

items: Death Resistance uses the damage that actually reaches your health, after armor, Resistance and yellow hearts
Death Resistance doesn't protect against /kill or falling into the void
Death Resistance triggers before a Totem of Undying: with enough XP, the totem isn't used up

entries.title: Ore Drop Multiplier
entries.summary: Warframe stat: ore drops multiplied after Fortune

blocks.text: {lang:item.module.oreDropMultiplier} is a stat on <hl>Warframe mods</hl>: with such a mod installed, ore you break yourself drops more materials.
Warframe mods are upgrade cards you install in the [[warframe/warframe_table]], and they're always active on you. A stat is one of the lines written on the card.
Final amount = original drop amount × (1 + total stat × {cfg:kuva_lich.oreDropEffectMultiplier|pctv})

items: It multiplies again after Fortune
Fractions round up by chance: 3 raw iron × 1.3 = 3.9 gives 4 nine times out of ten and 3 otherwise
No cap; anything over a full stack drops as several piles
A negative total does <g>not</g> reduce drops

blocks.text: What counts as ore
All vanilla ores, plus blocks other mods register as ores. Only materials like raw ore, diamonds and redstone are multiplied.
Mods with this stat
<dim>Bronze, Silver, Gold, Prime and Riven are mod tiers, see [[modules/module_rarity]].</dim>

The fixed mods in the table conflict with each other, so you can only install one. To go higher, add a [[modules/riven_module|Riven mod]] with this stat: a special mod with random stats, also limited to one.
<dim>Values shown are at max level; a mod below max level only gives part of it, see [[modules/module_level]].</dim>
Warframe's open-world maps have mining too: point a mining tool at a glowing deposit in the rock to extract ores and gems.
Advanced details

items: Ore blocks from Silk Touch, and drops that are themselves ore blocks, are not multiplied, so you can't place and re-mine them endlessly
Blocks blown up by TNT, creepers and other explosions don't count
{item:kuvalich:requiem_ore} and {item:kuvalich:experience_ore} roll their drops separately and are not affected
Limits on individual stat values: [[modules/module_limits]]

entries.title: Other Loot Sources
entries.summary: Endo from kills, Loot Drop Multiplier, Machete

blocks.text: Besides mining, here are other ways to get more loot. Drops specific to this mod's enemy, the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}, and its boss, the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}, are in [[enemies/kuva_slave]] and [[enemies/kuva_master]].
{item:kuvalich:endo}

Endo is the material for levelling up mods, and mods are upgrade cards you install in a weapon or on yourself. You get it by mining [[world/experience_ore]] and by breaking down unwanted mods in the [[weapons/requiem_recast]].

Monsters drop it too: killing a monster while holding a consecrated weapon in your main hand has a {cfg:kuva_lich.endoDropChance|pctv} chance to drop {cfg:kuva_lich.endoDropMinAmount}-{cfg:kuva_lich.endoDropMaxAmount}.

items: Consecrating a weapon lets it hold mods. [[weapons/kuva_weapons|Kuva weapons]] come consecrated; other weapons have to be consecrated first, see [[weapons/requiem_evolve]]
Only monsters count: zombies, skeletons, creepers, Kuva Thralls and so on. Animals (hoglins included), slimes, ghasts, phantoms and shulkers don't

items.text: This drop is not affected by the Loot Drop Multiplier below

blocks.text: {lang:kuvaweapon.warframe_attribute_type.itemDropMultiplier}
This is a stat on <hl>Warframe mods</hl> that makes the mobs you kill drop more. Warframe mods are installed in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_warframe_table} and are always active on you.
Drop amount × (1 + total stat × {cfg:kuva_lich.itemDropEffectMultiplier|pctv})

items: Applies when you personally kill an animal or monster; bow and gun kills count too
Multiplies what it would normally drop, like rotten flesh, bones and gunpowder
Armor, weapons, tools and anything with durability are <t>never</t> multiplied
No cap; anything over a full stack drops as several piles
A negative total reduces drops: at 0 or below, nothing but equipment drops
The kill-stack version of this stat gains one stack per kill, up to {cfg:kuva_lich.maxStacksItemDropMultiplier} stacks, see [[combat/kill_stack]]

items.text: Completely separate from the [[world/ore_drop_multiplier|Ore Drop Multiplier]]; each multiplies on its own

blocks.text: In Warframe, players farming for drops often bring the Warframe Nekros: his Desecrate ability gives nearby corpses a chance to drop their loot a second time.
{item:kuvalich:machete}

The {item:kuvalich:machete} is a [[weapons/kuva_weapons|Kuva weapon]] whose special effect is extra loot. Kill an animal or monster with it in your main hand and each drop pile is multiplied by its own random <g>1-3</g>.

items: Armor, swords, pickaxes, axes, shovels and hoes are never multiplied

items.text: The Machete applies first, then the Loot Drop Multiplier multiplies its result, so the two stack

items: The weapon itself: [[weapons/weapon_list]]

blocks.text: Advanced details

items.text: Slimes, magma cubes, ghasts, phantoms, shulkers, squid, fish, villagers and golems count as neither animal nor monster, so they get no Loot Drop Multiplier
The extra Kuva, Riven Slivers and mods from Kuva Thralls and Kuva Liches are not affected by the Loot Drop Multiplier
CustomNPCs NPCs count as well; killing them also gets the Loot Drop Multiplier
When you kill with a TACZ gun, the gun's {lang:item.module.gun_loot_drop} is added to the total, see [[tacz/tacz_gun_attributes]]

items: Bosses that can't travel through portals, like the Wither, aren't affected by the Machete
